title: LoadingState
responsibility: Show a reusable, accessible loading status with a decorative indicator while the host waits for data.

inputs.name: LoadingState.label
inputs.description: Optional status label describing the data being read; defaults to Loading…. The host owns fetching and decides when to show or remove the status.

outputs.name: LoadingState
outputs.description: A polite, atomic status with a decorative ring centered in the viewport and its label below. Pointer events pass through; reduced motion keeps the ring still.
